scores.tell: Clock is clean and almost vector-flat: an evenly bright, puffy orange rim and graphic ticks, with less painted richness than the real cards
Hat crown is slightly lumpy and airbrushed; otherwise the radial-ray backdrop and soft felt match the real glove card
Anchor is an inflated, uniform toy-plastic navy tube shape, like a statue, with no material variation
Puffy, thick orange bezel with lacquer-even plastic and a simplified graphic dial; the clock fills the card edge to edge
Glass has slightly too many sharp white hot spots and a hot orange glow; otherwise close to the real mojito card
Flat side-on painterly 2D seahorse on a soft underwater ray gradient; a different illustration style with no 3D volume or graphic backdrop
Photoreal, noisy sand grain next to a glossy inflated vinyl ball with sharp hot spots
Locker is a single even glossy orange enamel and the busy prop-filled interior is slightly more detailed than real cards
Same puffy, lacquer-even orange bezel and graphic, vector-like dial as the other clocks
Over-glossy, saturated blue balloon-sausage anchor with large sharp specular hits; reads as a plastic statue
